tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Yanfei expressing fear, using only the supplied approved neutral as the image reference. Preserve her identity, face, skin tone, hair, costume, accessories, colors and rendering, and the approved neutral's body proportions. Concerned wide eyes and raised brows; take a cautious step back, her right hand near her chest and her left hand relaxed at her side, clearly separated.. Keep the normal pupils. Each visible hand belongs to its own wrist and has one anatomically placed thumb and four fingers connected to one palm; digits naturally together, without forcing hidden digits into view. No merged hands, missing hands or extra digits. Exactly two legs and two feet from one pelvis, naturally posed and clearly readable. Show the entire silhouette, including hair, headwear, hands, accessories and shoes, with roughly 2–4% padding at the top and bottom. True transparent background. No scenery, text, UI, weapons, companions, floating effects, watermark or ground shadow.
